start_in: Who this user is, in their words: goals, skills, constraints, vocabulary
audit_in: Existing vision, functional guidelines, vocabulary and personas. Selected by script, index first
audit_out: Delta: duplicate, contradiction, hole, gap with the vision, principles or vocabulary (flagged, never blocking), overlap with an existing persona
Proposed scope, drawn from the project vocabulary. To validate at the gate
write_out: Persona proposed in fixed format (goals, skills, constraints, vocabulary, usage context, way of using the product: device, input mode, accessibility needs), without status
check_out: Valid schema, scope from the vocabulary, ambiguous words, no duplicate of an existing persona, way of using the product filled in

judge_questions.q: Is the persona distinct from the other personas?
Is the persona free of prescribed behavior?

judge_out: Yes or no: is the persona distinct from the other personas? is the persona free of prescribed behavior?
gate_in: Code checks and judge, all green
gate_out: Or changes: back to the intent

steps.title: Accepted · merge
out: Persona in the wiki, available for the Recette

contract: A type of user to describe.
An accepted persona in the wiki, available for the Recette and for the user flows that cite it.
Human F, at the gate. No human T.
notes: A script opens it only if the auditor's delta is not empty. Otherwise writing follows directly. The discussion is a loop between the human and the auditor, with no maximum number of rounds: at each round, the auditor receives the delta and the messages exchanged since its last round.
It has no status and is not itself recetted: it steers the Recettes that use it.
The AI rephrases, it does not invent
The intent comes from human F, with what they know of their real users. A persona invented by the AI would only be a cliché.
A user flow cites its personas and belongs to the User flow workflow.
doc.lede: A human F describes a type of user. The result is a persona entry of the wiki that the Recette uses to steer what it plays. The AI rephrases, it does not invent.
